methodology: Concise, source-linked business overviews for the editorial candidate map. These are company descriptions, not investment recommendations or live market data.

AAPL.summary: Apple makes iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods and Vision Pro. Its software platforms support services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud and Apple TV.

MSFT.summary: Microsoft operates productivity and business software, cloud services and personal computing businesses. Its products include Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows, LinkedIn, Dynamics and Xbox.
MSFT.sourceLabel: Microsoft FY2025 annual report · Business segments

NVDA.summary: NVIDIA develops chips, systems and software for accelerated computing and AI. Its platforms also serve computer graphics and digital-twin applications.

AMD.summary: AMD designs processors, graphics products, AI accelerators and adaptive computing platforms for PCs, gaming, embedded systems and data centers.

AEHR.summary: Aehr Test Systems provides semiconductor test and burn-in equipment for wafers, individual dies and packaged devices, including power semiconductors and AI processors.

GOOGL.summary: Alphabet comprises Google Services, Google Cloud and Other Bets. Google Services includes Search, YouTube, Android and Maps, while Google Cloud sells infrastructure, platform and enterprise applications.
GOOGL.sourceLabel: Alphabet Investor Relations · Segments and allocations

META.summary: Meta's Family of Apps includes Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp. Its Reality Labs segment develops virtual- and augmented-reality hardware, software and content.

CRM.summary: Salesforce provides cloud-based customer relationship management software and a platform that connects customer data, business applications and AI agents.

PLTR.summary: Palantir builds software platforms that integrate customers' data and operations. Its principal platforms are Gotham, Foundry, Apollo and the Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP).

RDDT.summary: Reddit is an online network of communities organized around interests, hobbies and discussions where people share and discover content.

AMZN.summary: Amazon offers online shopping, cloud computing, streaming entertainment, consumer devices, advertising, healthcare and AI services, supported by a global operations network.

WMT.summary: Walmart operates retail stores, Sam's Club membership warehouses and ecommerce sites in the United States and internationally.

COST.summary: Costco operates membership warehouses and ecommerce sites that sell a limited selection of branded and private-label merchandise across groceries and general goods.

TGT.summary: Target is a general merchandise retailer offering exclusive and national brands through its stores, online shop and delivery services.

ETSY.summary: Etsy operates an online marketplace for unique and creative goods, connecting independent sellers with buyers seeking handcrafted, designed and vintage items.

TSLA.summary: Tesla designs, builds, sells and services electric vehicles, solar-energy products and battery-storage systems.

GM.summary: General Motors builds vehicles under the Chevrolet, Buick, GMC and Cadillac brands. It also offers automotive financing, software services, insurance and parts.

F.summary: Ford develops Ford trucks, SUVs, commercial vans and cars, along with Lincoln luxury vehicles and connected services.

RIVN.summary: Rivian designs and assembles electric consumer and commercial vehicles, including the R1T pickup and R1S SUV, supported by in-house hardware and software platforms.

SMP.summary: Standard Motor Products manufactures and distributes automotive aftermarket replacement parts and develops vehicle-control and thermal-management components for vehicle and equipment makers.

JPM.summary: JPMorgan Chase serves consumers and businesses through banking, investing and payments, and serves institutions through commercial and investment banking and asset and wealth management.

GS.summary: Goldman Sachs provides investment banking and markets services, including financing and trading, alongside asset and wealth management.

V.summary: Visa operates a global network and technology platform that connects financial institutions, businesses, governments and consumers for digital payments and money movement.

HOOD.summary: Robinhood provides retail brokerage, cryptocurrency, advisory and digital-banking services, along with access to private markets.

ALLY.summary: Ally is a digital financial-services company offering banking, automotive and corporate financing, insurance, investment advisory and securities brokerage services.

JNJ.summary: Johnson & Johnson develops and sells medicines and medical technologies. Its two operating areas are Innovative Medicine and MedTech.

UNH.summary: UnitedHealth Group operates UnitedHealthcare, which provides health benefits, and Optum, which delivers care, pharmacy services, technology and data-enabled health services.

LLY.summary: Eli Lilly is a medicine company researching, manufacturing and supplying treatments. Its stated focus areas include Alzheimer's disease, cancer, diabetes and obesity.

ISRG.summary: Intuitive develops systems and services for minimally invasive care, including robotic-assisted surgical and bronchoscopy platforms.

HIMS.summary: Hims & Hers operates a health and wellness platform that connects customers with access to personalized care and related treatments.

CAT.summary: Caterpillar manufactures construction and mining equipment, engines, gas turbines and locomotives. It also offers equipment financing through Cat Financial.

DE.summary: Deere makes equipment for agriculture, turf, construction and forestry, serving customers such as farmers, ranchers and construction crews.

GE.summary: GE Aerospace, the business behind ticker GE, makes aircraft propulsion systems and provides related services and systems for commercial and military aviation.

HII.summary: HII builds and maintains naval ships through Ingalls and Newport News Shipbuilding. Its Mission Technologies division supplies defense systems and services.

LECO.summary: Lincoln Electric makes industrial welding, cutting and brazing products, along with process automation systems used in manufacturing and equipment maintenance.

XOM.summary: ExxonMobil operates upstream oil and gas, fuel and chemical product businesses, and a Low Carbon Solutions business focused on technologies such as carbon capture.

CVX.summary: Chevron produces crude oil and natural gas and manufactures transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals and additives.

COP.summary: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports and markets crude oil, natural gas, natural gas liquids and liquefied natural gas.

OXY.summary: Occidental produces oil and gas, manufactures chemicals through OxyChem, and operates midstream and marketing businesses. It also develops carbon management projects.

PBF.summary: PBF Energy refines crude oil into transportation fuels and other petroleum products. Its logistics business handles terminals, pipelines and storage assets.

NEE.summary: NextEra Energy owns Florida Power & Light, a regulated electric utility, and NextEra Energy Resources, an energy infrastructure developer.

DUK.summary: Duke Energy operates electric and natural gas utilities across several U.S. states and invests in power generation and grid infrastructure.

SO.summary: Southern Company operates electric utilities, natural gas distribution businesses and wholesale energy services through its family of companies.

VST.summary: Vistra combines competitive power generation with retail electricity services. Its generation portfolio includes natural gas, nuclear, coal, solar and battery storage.

AMT.summary: American Tower is a real estate investment trust that owns, operates and develops communications sites, including towers, and operates data center facilities.

LIN.summary: Linde supplies industrial, specialty and healthcare gases and provides engineering solutions for sectors including manufacturing, electronics, healthcare and energy.

FCX.summary: Freeport-McMoRan operates mining assets focused on copper, with gold and molybdenum reserves and operations in the Americas and Indonesia.

NEM.summary: Newmont is a gold mining company that also produces copper, silver, zinc, lead and molybdenum through its global operations.

MP.summary: MP Materials mines and refines rare earth materials at Mountain Pass in California and manufactures permanent magnets in Texas.

AA.summary: Alcoa produces alumina and aluminum products, with operations spanning bauxite mining, alumina refining and aluminum smelting.
